This ensures that a failed `register()` leaves zero partial state — no plugin name in the mapping, no hook implementations installed — so callers can fix their plugin and retry with the same name.

## Tests Added

- `test_register_partial_failure_leaves_no_state`: Verifies that a plugin with a valid `a_hook` and invalid `b_hook` leaves no plugin name in `_name2plugin` and no hook implementations on any `HookCaller` after `PluginValidationError`.
- `test_register_partial_failure_allows_retry`: Verifies that after a failed registration, a fixed plugin can successfully register using the same name and the hooks work correctly.
